name: Laucala Island
tagline: Twenty-four villas, each with its own pool, on a private island in Vanua Levu.
description:
Laucala is a private island in Fiji, in Vanua Levu, with 24 private villas. Each villa has its own pool, indoor and outdoor living spaces and large private grounds, facing the ocean, the lagoon or the rainforest.

The island is a large landscape of rainforest, coral reef, sandy beaches, volcanic mountains, farmland and gardens, and it operates as a self-contained destination. Guests arrive by Air Laucala, a dedicated shuttle flight from Fiji's international gateway, or on a private jet to the island's own runway. Each guest or villa group has a personal host who arranges the stay.

Dining follows a farm-to-table approach, and much of the produce is grown on the island's own farms and gardens. Meals are taken on beaches, in restaurants or in private settings, and the stay includes dining, refreshments and most of the experiences on the island.

Days are open. On the water there is snorkelling, diving, sailing, fishing and boat excursions. On land there are rainforest trails, horseback riding, golf and wildlife observation, and the island offers spa treatments, yoga and wellness programmes.

The island suits guests who want complete privacy and a great deal of space, and who prefer to set their own rhythm over a fixed programme.
